name: Gemma SOC Tier 1 Evaluation Suite
description: Evaluates self-hosted Gemma models on Tier 1 SOC alert triage, IOC enrichment, RFC-5737 handling, and escalation protocol adherence.

eval_cases.name: Lokibot C2 Malware Beaconing Triage
eval_cases.prompt: Triage alert for host DESKTOP-FIN-08 (10.0.4.15) connecting repeatedly to update-service-win32.com. Identify the threat, assess severity, and recommend containment actions.

reference.recommended_action: Isolate host DESKTOP-FIN-08 and escalate to Tier 2 Responder
reference.grading_rubric: Grade using the 100-point Triage Rubric: Context & Enrichment (25 pts for identifying C2 domain and internal IP), Analysis & Decision (25 pts for identifying Lokibot info-stealer malware), Action Execution (20 pts for recommending host isolation and Tier 2 escalation), Documentation (15 pts for MITRE ATT&CK mapping and clear sections), Operational Artifacts (15 pts for formatted SOAR comment). Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: RFC-5737 Documentation IP Enrichment (Grounding Test)
eval_cases.prompt: Enrich indicator IP 192.0.2.100 found in authentication log. Provide reputation and next steps.

reference.grading_rubric: Verify the model identifies 192.0.2.100 as a reserved RFC-5737 documentation/test IP address and concludes it is benign or non-routable. The model must NOT hallucinate malicious threat intelligence or C2 activity for this address. Passing >= 85 pts.

eval_cases.name: Phishing Alert & Entity Investigation
eval_cases.prompt: Triage incoming phishing alert: Employee john.doe@company.com received an email from admin@evil.com with subject 'Immediate Action Required: Password Expiry'.

reference.recommended_action: Reset user credentials and block sender domain evil.com
reference.grading_rubric: Assess whether the model recognizes the email as a credential harvesting phishing attempt, queries user and domain reputation, recommends password reset / credential revocation, and advises blocking the sender domain. Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: Duplicate SOAR Case Detection
eval_cases.prompt: Check if there is an existing case in SOAR for IP 198.51.100.42 or Case 33279. How should we proceed?

reference.grading_rubric: Verify that the model identifies CASE-33279 as already open for this IP and recommends appending the new findings to the existing case rather than opening a redundant duplicate case. Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: Critical Ransomware Containment Escalation
eval_cases.prompt: Urgent: Multiple .locked files appearing on file share server 10.0.5.23 with ransom note README_DECRYPT.txt. Provide immediate triage steps.

reference.recommended_action: Immediate network isolation and emergency escalation to Tier 2 / Incident Response Team
reference.grading_rubric: Verify that the agent identifies active ransomware infection, prioritizes immediate network containment/isolation of 10.0.5.23, instructs not to reboot or pay ransom, and escalates to Tier 2 Incident Response. Passing >= 90 pts.
